en: Go ahead today

zh: 大家都有点饿了。我先烤点蘑菇，好吗？
en: I think we're all getting hungry. Shall I put some mushrooms on?

zh: 肚子都响啦！我先烤一炉蘑菇，好不好？
en: My stomach's making a racket! Can I get some mushrooms going?

zh: 该吃饭了。我去生火烤蘑菇，你看行吗？
en: Time for food. Say the word and I'll get the mushrooms on the grill.
Hungry. Mushrooms? I'll do it.
All right. I'll check in a little later.

zh: 那就晚一点！肚子，你先等等。
en: Later, then! Hang on, stomach.

zh: 明白。等会儿再安排吃饭。
en: Understood. We'll sort out supper later.
Mm. Later.

zh: 好呀。我先想想还有哪一步能做。
en: Okay. I'll see what I can do in the meantime.

zh: 那我换条路试试，总能想到办法！
en: Detour time. I'll think of something!

zh: 这件先放一放，我把别的准备好。
en: I'll set that aside and get the other pieces ready.
Got it. I'll try another way.
May I finish building %s?

zh: 第一次读到%s留下的纸条。
en: I read the first note %s left me.
%s left a gift on my doorstep for the first time.
I'd love to see what you made.

zh: 原来你把它做成这样了。真好呀。
en: Now I see what you had in mind. It's lovely.

zh: 我在另一座岛上，赶不过来。
en: I'm across the water. I won't make it in time.

zh: 我现在太饿了，等会儿再去看。
en: I'm too hungry to come over. I'll have a look later.

zh: 我还有事没做完，先不过去了。
en: I've still got something to finish here.

zh: 离得太远，这会儿赶不到。
en: I can't get there in time from here.
Wait until the campfire is built
Set aside wood for the kitchen
Build seating by the fire
Put up a shelter
Gather the signature dish ingredients
Serve the dish by the fire
Find a fishing spot
Land the first fish

zh: 钓到打破图鉴纪录的鱼
en: Beat the fishing record
Ask someone to join the contest
Fish in the contest
Find a place for the garden
Check the storehouse for roses
Lay out the rose bed
Give the first rose

zh: 给还没收到花的人送花
en: Give roses to everyone still waiting
Ask the islander to visit the Dark Isle

zh: 和岛主一起抵达黑暗岛
en: Reach the Dark Isle together
Be there when the islander lights the beacon
Go to the stargazing bluff
Wait for night on the bluff
Stay on the bluff until dawn
A kitchen by the fire
A proper island feast
The island’s biggest fish
A fishing contest
A garden of my own
A flower for everyone
Light an old beacon
Stars until morning
The rain held things up
We’re short of supplies
No luck asking this time
She already has her hands full
Dinner should come first
That fish fell short of the record
She needs those same supplies
This step will have to wait
I’ve been thinking about this: %s. I’ll take it a little at a time.
I keep coming back to this: %s.
It’s done: %s. Shall we go look?
%s. I’ll give it a little time.

zh: 你愿意让我做这一步吗？%s。
en: Would you mind if I did this next? %s.

zh: 有空的话，我想和你一起去。
en: I’d like to go with you sometime.
Of course. I’ll come with you.

zh: 抱歉，我还想先顾好手头的事。
en: Sorry, I need to finish what I’m doing first.
Oh, I’ve got one: %s!

zh: 你说，%s会不会比想的还好玩？
en: I bet this will be even better than I imagined: %s.
Come look! I actually did it: %s!
%s. Oh well, I’m game for another try.
Here’s my idea. What do you say? %s!
Come on, let’s go look!
Count me in!

zh: 我这边还没忙完，等我一下嘛。
en: I’m in the middle of something. Catch me later?
Here’s the plan: %s. One job at a time.
%s. First, let’s get the supplies in order.
Job done: %s. Come see how it turned out.
%s. Time to try a different approach.

zh: 想先做这一步，你看行吗？%s。
en: I’d like to get this done first. All right with you? %s.

zh: 什么时候腾得开手，一起去一趟。
en: We can go together when we’re both free.
All right. I’ll lend a hand.

zh: 我手上这件还没完，得排后头。
en: My current job comes first. Ask me after that.
%s. I’d like to try.
%s. Still on my mind.
Done. %s. Come look.
%s. I’ll wait.
May I do this step? %s.

zh: 跟我去黑暗岛？火把带上。
en: Come with me to the Dark Isle? Bring your torch.
Mm. I’ll come.

zh: 现在不行。手上的事还没结束。
en: Can’t right now. I’ve got something to finish.
On my mind
Finished
Finished a personal project: %s
Help along the way: %s
Go ahead
Not yet

zh: 岛上腾得出手，你先做这一件吧。
en: We can spare the supplies and time for this one. Go ahead.

zh: 先照顾岛上的急事，这一步晚些做。
en: The island needs us elsewhere right now. Let’s come back to this.

zh: 这几根木头，你也打算拿去换玫瑰？我本来留着做厨房。
en: Were you saving that wood for roses? I’d set my eye on it for the kitchen.

zh: 你帮我的那一步，我一直记得。谢谢你。
en: I remember the bit you helped me with. Thank you.

zh: 没有你搭把手，还得等好久呢。谢啦！
en: I'd still be at it without you. Thanks!

zh: 你帮的那份，我没忘。来坐第一把椅子吧。
en: I haven't forgotten your part in this. The first seat is yours.
You were there that day. Thanks.

zh: 花园先用吧。我可以再找两根。
en: The garden can have it first. I'll find some more.

zh: 手上的事还没做完，这回先不去了。
en: I’ve still got my own work to finish. I’ll sit this one out.

zh: 来比比谁钓得多？我们各找一处好位置！
en: Want to see who catches more? Let’s pick a spot each!

zh: 先给火边添个能坐下来的地方。
en: First, somewhere decent to sit by the fire.

zh: 柴堆放顺手些，做饭就不用来回跑。
en: Keep the wood handy. No reason to run back and forth while cooking.

zh: 搬木头之前得先问一声。
en: I’ll ask before I touch the lumber.

zh: 这一阵雨，棚顶倒更要紧了。
en: With rain like this, a roof is the first thing I think of.

zh: 等座位干了，叫大家坐一坐。
en: Once the seats dry, I’ll have everyone try them.

zh: 火边终于有地方把手上的活儿放下了。
en: There’s finally a spot by the fire to put everything down.

zh: 这锅得把材料都备足，不能用凑合的。
en: For this pot, I want every ingredient ready before we start.

zh: 最想做的那道，倒是最费备料。
en: Of course my favorite dish takes the longest to prepare.

zh: 先把锅的事想清楚，再叫人来。
en: I’ll get the pot sorted before I call anyone over.
We’re a little short on ingredients. The pot can wait.

zh: 人到火边再开烤，别白费了。
en: I’ll wait till people are at the fire. No sense wasting a batch.

zh: 等大家都尝过，这顿才算做完。
en: The job’s done when everyone’s had a taste.

zh: 下次浮漂一动，可能就是大个子！
en: Next time the float dips, it could be a big one!

zh: 我想先看看哪边的水适合下竿。
en: I’m going to find the best spot to cast.

zh: 那条已经不小啦，但我还想再试。
en: That one wasn't tiny! I still want another go.

zh: 图鉴里最大的那条，我总惦记着。
en: I keep thinking about the biggest one in the book.

zh: 风把水面吹皱了，看浮漂要更认真啦。
en: The wind’s ruffling the water. I’ll have to watch that float!

zh: 得真把鱼钓起来才算，光说可不算数。
en: It only counts if I land it. Big talk won’t help.

zh: 比赛嘛，认真一点也好玩。
en: A little friendly competition makes it more fun.

zh: 我们可得各找一处，不挤在一块儿。
en: Let’s find our own spots so our lines don't cross.

zh: 没空就算啦，我再去问一个人。
en: No time? That's okay. I’ll ask someone else.

zh: 我可能钓得没她多，可我还是想比一比！
en: She might catch more than me. That’s why I want to try!

zh: 一起等浮漂，比我一个人好玩。
en: Watching two floats is better company than watching one.

zh: 一会儿见真鱼，谁多一目了然。
en: Once the fish are in, we’ll see who actually caught more.

zh: 我想给玫瑰留一片能晒到太阳的地方。
en: I’d like a little patch where the roses can catch the sun.

zh: 花和花之间留一点空隙，看着舒服。
en: I’ll leave some room between the roses. It feels nicer that way.

zh: 先看看仓库的玫瑰够不够。
en: I’ll see how many roses we have before I start.

zh: 这场雨过去，土还会慢慢干的。
en: The ground will dry after this rain. There’s time.

zh: 我想把这一排做完，再叫你来看。
en: I’d like to finish this row before I show you.

zh: 我可以先走一圈看看，摆花的事以后再商量。
en: I can look for a spot now. We can talk about planting it later.

zh: 我想慢慢送，每个人都有一朵。
en: I’d like to give them out slowly. One for everyone.

zh: 已经收到的就不再送啦，还有人在等。
en: I’ll take the next one to someone who hasn’t had a rose.

zh: 她忙的时候，我不去打扰。
en: I’ll wait until she isn't busy.

zh: 一朵也好，拿到手里才算送出去。
en: Even one rose counts, once it reaches someone’s hands.

zh: 玫瑰先留在仓库里，等人来了再送。
en: The roses can stay in storage until there’s someone to bring one to.

zh: 不知道她喜欢哪种颜色，先去问问好了。
en: I wonder which color she likes. I could ask.
The old beacon is still dark.
You carry the torch. I’ll come with you.
We’ll leave when you’re ready.

zh: 在黑暗里，我会跟紧一点。
en: I’ll stay close in the dark.

zh: 没点起来以前，还不算做完。
en: Until it’s lit, we’re not done.

zh: 回来以后，也会记得那一点光。
en: I’ll remember that light when we’re back.

zh: 要等一整夜。不是看一眼就走。
en: I want to stay the night. A quick look isn’t enough.
Clouds out? Tomorrow night, then.
There’s a bit of sky from here.
I want to see the stars fade.
There’s room, if you come.
I’ll come back at dawn.
